@@ -9,18 +9,25 @@ export const MODE_CONFIGS: Record<GameMode, ModeConfig> = {
 
 export type ModeEndReason = 'stack-out' | 'target-lines' | 'time-up';
 
+/** sprint / time 可选的档位 */
+export const SPRINT_TARGETS = [20, 40] as const;
+export const TIME_LIMITS = [60, 120, 180] as const;
+
 export interface ModeEndCheck {
   mode: GameMode;
   lines: number;
   elapsedSec: number;
   /** 新方块无法生成（堆满） */
   stackOut: boolean;
+  /** 覆盖默认目标：sprint 目标行数 / time 时长（秒） */
+  override?: Partial<ModeConfig>;
 }
 
 /** 按模式判定是否结束；返回结束原因，未结束返回 null */
 export function checkModeEnd(check: ModeEndCheck): ModeEndReason | null {
   if (check.stackOut) return 'stack-out';
-  if (check.mode === 'sprint' && check.lines >= MODE_CONFIGS.sprint.target) return 'target-lines';
-  if (check.mode === 'time' && check.elapsedSec >= MODE_CONFIGS.time.target) return 'time-up';
+  const cfg = { ...MODE_CONFIGS[check.mode], ...check.override };
+  if (check.mode === 'sprint' && check.lines >= cfg.target) return 'target-lines';
+  if (check.mode === 'time' && check.elapsedSec >= cfg.target) return 'time-up';
   return null;
 }
